claims.claim: Johann Wolfgang Döbereiner, a German chemist, invented a lighter (Döbereiner's lamp) in 1823.
Inside the jar, zinc reacts with dilute sulfuric acid to make hydrogen gas.
Opening the valve sends hydrogen onto a platinum sponge, which heats up and ignites the gas (no spark needed).
John Walker, a chemist in Stockton-on-Tees, invented the friction match in 1826; first recorded sale 7 April 1827.
Neither Döbereiner nor Walker patented their invention.

rejected.claim: Over a million Döbereiner lamps were sold in the 1820s.
rejected.reason: Only hedged sources ('it is said'); not used.
